## Problem and behavior / 问题与变化

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. 说明复现条件和改动后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Native changes on macOS / 涉及 Swift 时：`npm run setup:mac`
- [ ] User guides aligned in English and Chinese / 中英文用户指南同步（如适用）

For UI changes include dimensions and redacted screenshots. Distinguish simulated input from actual device results and list gaps.

UI 变更附尺寸与脱敏截图；输入变更写明真实设备 / 模拟验证及未覆盖项。

## Limits / 限制

Remaining risks, compatibility or migration needs. 剩余风险、兼容性或迁移要求（如有）。
